descriptionChirho: Proper name Yehu (יֵהוּא), primarily the zealous king of Israel who overthrew the house of Ahab and destroyed Baal worship (2 Kings 9-10); also borne by a prophet (1 Chr 12:3) and others. The bare nominative and prepositional le- forms denote the same individual(s). Target languages are consistent: Spanish Jehú, Hindi येहू, Arabic يَاهُو, Korean 예후, Swahili Yehu — all rendering this proper name uniformly across grammatical cases.
